option_relations.rationale: Primary iris B-cell lymphoma is a broader category that encompasses primary iris lymphoma with ciliary body involvement.
Primary B-cell lymphoma of the iris (CD20+) is a broader category that encompasses primary iris lymphoma with ciliary body involvement, as the biopsy showed CD20+ lymphocytes.

Intraocular marginal zone lymphoma (MALT lymphoma) is a specific type of B-cell lymphoma that can affect the iris and ciliary body, making it a supertype of the more general 'Primary Iris Lymphoma with ciliary body involvement'.

Primary B-cell mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT) lymphoma of the iris is a specific type of B-cell lymphoma that can affect the iris and ciliary body, making it a supertype of the more general 'Primary Iris Lymphoma with ciliary body involvement'.
